newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse revamps general share index.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse revamps general share index.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange revamped its benchmark general share index to better reflect market trends, it said on Thursday.
The new general share index will include fewer companies, 60 from 76 previously. They were selected based on their market capitalisation and marketability during the first half of 1996.

"The 60 shares make up 75.94 percent of the market capitalisation on August 31 and 69.45 percent of trading volume in the first half. The previous 76-share index made up 78.32 percent of market cap and 71.4 percent of trading volume," the exchange said.
